additional_info.subject: AW: ID0437753-DC/Si-D/DE-{Y2 / S5 313651774001}Cleanup Unregistered ID Tags CRM:02681000474
additional_info.body:
Hello Francisco,
many thanks for the fast response. So it is quite easy to find the serial number.
Yes, I am able to onboard new vehicles. The problem is that I don't have the ID tags of the new trucks to hand in advance. Therefore, I usually have to try every single ID tag listed under “Unregistered ID tags”. This makes the whole process very time intense and due to the current amount of 14 unregistered ID Tags very complicated.
We've already had a lot of foreign cars here that thought they could charge electricity in our yard. That's why we had it specially set up so that only registered ID tags are permitted.
Nevertheless, the overview still shows all the vehicles that wanted to fill up with electricity.
It would be nice if users could delete the list themselves.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Nils Jepsen
